execution.nativeGuard: fixed 6 GiB active AND observed cumulative MLX peak, checked after load and before/after encode

fit.selection: one reviewed semantic-factor method; no held-out tuning

fusion.objective: mean TRAIN query BCE + mean unique TRAIN catalog-variant BCE; equal role weights

prior.objective: independent unique TRAIN catalog BCE only

policy.objective: mean TRAIN query BCE + mean unique TRAIN catalog-variant BCE; equal role weights
policy.productReadout: dot of predicted query/catalog atom probabilities; mean over product variants
policy.prior: independent catalog BCE fit; query factor fixed to empirical TRAIN preference frequencies
policy.image: byte-identical frozen centered-v1 fusion checkpoint; no image updates
policy.targets: public TRAIN statedPreferences and product tags only; no relevance/image labels

config.queryMeanMembership: exact paired TRAIN query rows, each once
config.catalogMeanMembership: unique paired TRAIN candidate variant members, each once
config.architecture: unchanged rank4 tanh fusion, 32786 trainable parameters
config.selection: one fixed conditioning ablation; no learning-rate search or held-out tuning

limitations: Public seven-atom grammar distillation; no latent preference or conversion claim.
Old catalog and held-out outcomes already inspected/replayed; not untouched test evidence.
Frozen image behavior inherited from centered-v1; no new image, copy or section learning.
Cached CPU timing excludes native request extraction and full page generation.
